name: agentic-qe-fleet
description: PACTS-based agentic quality engineering fleet — 11 specialized QE agents, sublinear coverage analysis, chaos/resilience testing, and TDD skills for Claude Code

llm_provider.title: LLM provider
llm_provider.description: Pins the provider the AQE MCP server routes LLM calls to (sets AQE_LLM_PROVIDER), e.g. claude-code, claude, openrouter, ollama. Leave empty to use llm-config.json / environment auto-detection. Unknown values are ignored with a warning.

max_budget_usd.title: Per-run LLM budget cap (USD)
max_budget_usd.description: Per-run spend cap for metered LLM providers (sets AQE_MAX_BUDGET_USD). 0 = no cap from the plugin (llm-config.json global.maxCostPerRun still applies).

memory_backend.title: Memory backend
memory_backend.description: hybrid = persist learning to .agentic-qe/memory.db in the project (default). memory = database-free mode: full feature parity, nothing written under .agentic-qe/ (sets AQE_MEMORY_BACKEND).

guardMode.title: AQE learning-data guard
guardMode.description: enforce (default): refuse Bash/Monitor/PowerShell/Write/Edit calls that delete, move, overwrite or truncate .agentic-qe/*.db (-wal, -shm, *.rvf) or run DROP/DELETE FROM/TRUNCATE/ALTER ... DROP against them. notify: allow, but toast and count. off: no checks.
